answer: The raven counter is kept in crystal and meadow makes public each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 14 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
